description: Render a template with sample variables and return the resulting subject and HTML, plus any {{placeholders}} that went unsubstituted — WITHOUT sending anything or writing a row to the send log. Use this while iterating on copy; use volanea_send_test_email only when you want a real logged message to inspect with volanea_check_delivery.
name: volanea_render_template

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

defaulted.description: Placeholders that fell back to their {{name | "default"}} value.

html.description: Rendered body. Nothing was sent or logged.

unresolved.description: Placeholders with no value supplied — these render empty in a real send.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
